description: Registration windows on record across clubs, for questions like 'which clubs in Ohio have registration open now' or 'what opens in January'. Filter by state, town, club name words, status and dates. Each window has its opening and closing dates, season, source link and verification.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, for the next page of the same search.

date.description: Only windows that cover this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

from.description: Only windows overlapping from this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: Words of a club's name or town.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example OH or PA.

to.description: Only windows overlapping up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD; a range is at most 400 days).

name: list_registration_windows
title: List registration windows
